page.overview:
Who is Shinobu?

Shinobu is a kunoichi from Wano Country and a retainer of the Kouzuki Family, having once served in the Oniwabanshu of the Kouzuki Shogunate and trained under Kin'emon as his protégée. She is also the younger sister of Shinosuke.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Wano Country Arc.

Despite her stout silhouette, Shinobu is quite tall, standing at 180 cm. However, when standing next to other people, she appears considerably shorter than that. As a middle-aged woman, she is considered rather ugly with her broad eyebrows, fat nose, and overall chubby face. She has brown hair tied in pigtails and wears over-the-top makeup, as well as a pink-colored kunoichi attire.

She was very beautiful when she was younger, able to capture the hearts of many of her foes according to Hanzo. 20 years ago, she wore a hot-pink, short dress with slits at the sides with a plunging neckline, revealing her cleavage. Her pigtails were much more longer and she wore a light-yellow scarf.
